description: This file defines classes and functions for extracting and iterating over configuration values related to build targets in a build system, specifically for the GN build tool. It includes an iterator class for traversing config values, functions for writing config values to streams, and related enums.

classes.name: ConfigValuesIterator
classes.description: An iterator class to traverse all configuration values applicable to a build target, including the target's own config values and those from applied configs.

methods.name: RecursiveTargetConfigToStream
methods.description: Writes all config values from a target and its configs to an output stream, optionally skipping duplicates.

methods.name: RecursiveTargetConfigStringsToStream
methods.description: Outputs config values as strings with no transformation, considering escape options.
